title: Could This Be America’s First Democratic Socialist Governor?
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
In politics, the state of Wisconsin is generally known for its swing state
voters, razor-thin margins, and in the past decade, its back-and-forth
[support](https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/4964446-trump-wins-
wisconsin-2024/) for U.S. President Donald Trump.

But democratic socialist and Wisconsin gubernatorial candidate **[Francesca
Hong](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/democratic-socialists-
eye-battleground-state-breakthrough-primary-rcna351135)** has a different
perspective.

**" This is also a state where progressivism was born and nurtured, where
kindergarten was formed," **Hong says to Mehdi. **" Our socialist progressive
roots run deep and the people all across our state are ready to dig up those
roots and build something new and better."**

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Watch **Mehdi** and Hong discuss her campaign, as she attempts to beat out
establishment Democrats in the state's primary and become the U.S.'s first
democratic socialist governor.

Key moments from the interview include:

  * What democratic socialism means to Hong **( "Human rights, democracy, and fairness.")**

  * The criticism from establishment Democrats that she is "unelectable"

  * Why she has not walked back her previous ["defund the police"](https://www.cnn.com/2026/05/22/politics/kfile-francesca-hong-wisconsin-governor-race-defund-police) comments **( "It is the responsible thing to demand reform.")**

  * Why she [reported](https://www.jsonline.com/story/news/politics/2026/07/07/francesca-hong-says-she-regrets-911-calls-over-gaza-protest-display/90773075007/?gnt-cfr=1&gca-cat=p&gca-uir=true&gca-epti=z11xx63p118650l118950c118650e1171xxv11xx63d--39--b--39--&gca-ft=254&gca-ds=sophi) a Gaza ceasefire display in 2023 as a "highly antisemitic act" and why regrets doing so today and is calling out Israel's genocide of Palestinians

  * The Republican party's likely gubernatorial nominee [Tom Tiffany](https://www.foxbusiness.com/video/6401027564112) **( "A traitor.")**

  * Whether she will repeal Wisconsin's [codification](https://www.wpr.org/news/wisconsin-adopted-an-antisemitism-definition-into-law-critics-say-it-could-chill-free-speech) of the controversial IHRA definition of antisemitism
